news.title: Kajal Aggarwal's The India Story Lands on OTT in Telugu and Tamil
news.summary: Kajal Aggarwal and Shreyas Talpade starrer The India Story has officially landed on JioHotstar in Telugu and Tamil. The multilingual film initially only received a Hindi theatrical release, skipping big screens in the south. The digital release gives regional audiences a fresh chance to watch the Chettan DK directorial.
body: The Kajal Aggarwal-starrer The India Story has officially made its way to digital platforms in regional languages, releasing in Telugu and Tamil on JioHotstar. While the makers originally planned a broad multilingual theatrical rollout, only the Hindi version secured a cinema release. That theatrical run failed to make a major impact at the box office.

After the Hindi version previously debuted on JioHotstar, the streaming platform has now added the Telugu and Tamil iterations. This rollout offers the film a secondary window to connect with viewers in the south who missed out during its limited theatrical cycle. The initial focus centers on whether the project can secure a more favorable reception among digital consumers.

Directed by Chettan DK, the feature stars Kajal Aggarwal and Shreyas Talpade in the leading roles. The supporting cast features Manish Wadhwa, Murli Sharma, Atul Tiwari, and Kamlesh Sawant, among others. The production was handled by Sagar B Shinde, while Mangesh Dhakde composed the soundtrack for the film.

news.title: Nagarjuna and Girija Shettar's Geethanjali 4K Re-Release Locked for November
news.summary: The 4K remastered version of Mani Ratnam's classic romantic drama Geethanjali is set to hit theatres on November 13, 2026. Starring Nagarjuna and Girija Shettar, the film was postponed from its initial August window to allow for extensive audio and visual restoration work. The 1989 film remains celebrated for its poetic narrative and Ilaiyaraaja's score.
body: The digitally enhanced 4K version of the classic film Geethanjali has secured a theatrical release date of November 13, 2026. The Mani Ratnam directorial was initially slated to arrive on August 28 to coincide with lead actor Nagarjuna's birthday, but the rollout was delayed to ensure thorough restoration work.

According to the team, the postponement allowed technicians to achieve the highest possible picture and sound quality using contemporary theatrical technology. Released originally in 1989, Geethanjali stands as Mani Ratnam's sole direct Telugu feature. The narrative follows two terminally ill individuals who find love and companionship despite their limited time.

The romantic drama continues to be remembered for PC Sreeram's cinematography of Ooty's landscapes and Ilaiyaraaja's musical score. With Nagarjuna and Girija Shettar's performances anchoring the emotional core, the upcoming 4K re-release intends to blend nostalgic appeal with upgraded big-screen presentation.

news.title: Young Tiger NTR Praises Fahadh Faasil's Dont Trouble The Trouble
news.summary: Jr NTR has shared high praise for the upcoming film Dont Trouble The Trouble, starring Fahadh Faasil and directed by debutant Shashank Yeleti. Lauding the emotional depth and child artist Sara's performance, NTR recommended the film as a complete family entertainer. The movie is scheduled to release on October 2, 2026.
body: Ahead of its release, the Fahadh Faasil-starrer Dont Trouble The Trouble has earned appreciation from prominent industry figures, with Jr NTR being the latest to endorse the project. Directed by debutant Shashank Yeleti, the film hits screens on October 2, 2026, and has drawn positive remarks from stars like Mahesh Babu as well.

Sharing his thoughts on the project, NTR commended the debut filmmaker for handling complex emotions effectively. He specifically highlighted child artist Sara's performance and praised Kaala Bhairava's background score for elevating the overall cinematic experience. According to the actor, the movie serves as an emotional roller coaster suitable for family audiences from start to finish.

NTR also expressed pride in Karthikeya for backing the venture as producer. The strong endorsements from leading actors have generated substantial pre-release momentum for the project as it heads into theatres.

news.title: Priyanka Chopra and Saif Ali Khan in Talks for Ritesh Batra's International Project
news.summary: Bollywood stars Priyanka Chopra and Saif Ali Khan are reportedly set to share the screen for the first time in an international feature directed by Ritesh Batra. While both actors boast extensive filmographies, they have never worked together in lead roles before. Batra is recognized for critically acclaimed dramas like The Lunchbox.
body: Bollywood fans may witness a brand-new on-screen pairing as Priyanka Chopra and Saif Ali Khan are reportedly aligned to star together in an upcoming international project. Media reports indicate that acclaimed filmmaker Ritesh Batra will direct the venture, marking the first time both established leads share screen space in their careers.

Ritesh Batra has earned international recognition through critically praised films such as The Lunchbox and Photograph, steering this new development as an overseas-focused venture. Both actors bring diverse experience to the table; Priyanka has built a significant global profile through projects like Citadel and Hollywood productions, while Saif continues to balance commercial and content-driven domestic cinema.

While Saif was recently seen in Priyadarshan's Haiwaan, Priyanka has been occupied with her comeback Indian film, Varanasi. The prospective collaboration has generated considerable curiosity among film enthusiasts as details regarding the plot are awaited.

news.title: Sandeep Reddy Vanga-Backed Romanchakam Debuts on Netflix
news.summary: Following its theatrical run, the film Romanchakam has officially arrived on Netflix in multiple languages. Backed by Sandeep Reddy Vanga and produced by Pranav Reddy Vanga under Bhadrakali Pictures, the project stars Sumanth Ashwin and Ananthika Sanilkumar.
body: Romanchakam, a feature film backed by filmmaker Sandeep Reddy Vanga and produced by his father Pranav Reddy Vanga under the banner Bhadrakali Pictures, has officially transitioned to the digital space. The movie is now streaming on Netflix in multiple language options following its theatrical run.

The film features Sumanth Ashwin and Ananthika Sanilkumar in the lead roles. The supporting cast includes Narendra Ravi, Venkatesh Kakumanu, Mani Aegurla, Sai Sohan, and Upendra Limaye. The musical score for the project was composed by Vasuki Vaibhav.

While the feature was promoted extensively by Sandeep Reddy Vanga prior to its theatrical release, it did not manage to draw the expected response from younger demographics in cinema halls. Its arrival on Netflix now provides the production team a fresh avenue to connect with a wider viewership and test its appeal among digital audiences.

news.title: Mayuri Film Distributors Announces Major Theatrical Comeback with Thella Kaagitham
news.summary: Mayuri Film Distributors, part of the Ramoji Group, is staging a major return to theatrical distribution after a long hiatus. The banner has selected the content-driven film Thella Kaagitham for its comeback, planning a wide release across Krishna district alongside paid premieres.
body: Mayuri Film Distributors, a well-known distribution entity operating under the Ramoji Group, is making its official return to the theatrical distribution sector following a prolonged break. The company has chosen to mark its comeback with a content-driven movie titled Thella Kaagitham, steering away from conventional star-led projects.

Historically recognized for establishing a corporate and systematic approach to distribution, Mayuri built its reputation during the 1990s through integrated operations, fair business practices, and extensive regional reach. At its peak, the network operated 19 distribution offices across Andhra Pradesh, leasing theaters across multiple cities and maintaining an active presence in every district.

The distribution house is preparing a wide release for Thella Kaagitham, scheduling the worldwide rollout alongside paid premieres. Advance bookings have already commenced in the Krishna district, drawing significant attention and curiosity from trade circles as the team kicks off its theatrical campaign.

news.title: Karthi’s Spy Action Thriller Sardar 2 Arrives on Amazon Prime Video
news.summary: Just three weeks after its theatrical debut, Karthi's spy action thriller Sardar 2 has landed on Amazon Prime Video. Directed by PS Mithran, the film features the actor in dual roles alongside an ensemble cast including SJ Suryah and Malavika Mohanan.
body: Tamil spy action thriller Sardar 2 has made its swift transition to the digital space, arriving on Amazon Prime Video just three weeks after its theatrical release. The film had opened in cinema halls amid high expectations but ultimately concluded its theatrical run on a disappointing note after failing to sustain the initial hype.

Directed by PS Mithran, the project features lead actor Karthi playing dual roles. The ensemble cast also includes SJ Suryah, Malavika Mohanan, Ashika Ranganath, and Rajisha Vijayan. It was produced by S Lakshman Kumar and Ishan Saksena under the banners of Prince Pictures and IVY Entertainment, with music scored by Sam CS.

The rapid OTT rollout gives the action venture a secondary platform to connect with viewers in multiple languages, including Telugu. Industry observers will be watching to see if the streaming release helps the title secure a more favorable reception among digital audiences.

news.title: Supporting Cast Steals the Spotlight in The Paradise
news.summary: While high-profile supporting roles in The Paradise faced mixed audience traction, actors Kranthi Balivada and Vishika have emerged with notable acclaim. Their respective performances and dubbing contributions have generated significant social media attention following the film's release.
body: The recent release of The Paradise has shifted focus toward its supporting cast, bringing distinct attention to actors Kranthi Balivada and Vishika. Despite pre-release buzz surrounding other prominent casting choices, these two performers have captured the spotlight through critical appreciation and audience recognition post-release.

Kranthi Balivada, who portrayed Kayadu Lohar’s mother on screen, also gained traction for her extensive voice-over work. Having previously dubbed for major ventures including the KGF franchise, her voice was utilized in the film's teaser, and her performance as a dubbing artist for Sonali Kulkarni—who played Sammakka—has drawn widespread notice. Transitioning from a biochemistry lectureship to anchoring and dubbing, Kranthi's dual involvement has marked a major milestone in her career.

Meanwhile, young actor Vishika has drawn praise for her performance in the film's second half. Having previously appeared in projects such as Court, Korean Kanakaraju, Patang, and Committee Kurrollu, her recent work in The Paradise has opened doors for potential opportunities in larger mainstream productions.

news.title: Stree 3 Officially Set for 2028 Release Following Mahavatar
news.summary: Producer Dinesh Vijan has confirmed that Stree 3 will arrive in cinemas in late 2028. Director Amar Kaushik has completed writing the script, which promises a complete narrative turnaround.
body: Producer Dinesh Vijan and actor Rajkummar Rao recently shared major updates regarding the popular horror-comedy franchise while appearing at FICCI Frames 2026. Vijan outlined the production timeline for the upcoming slate, confirming that director Amar Kaushik remains at the helm of the universe's upcoming projects.

Kaushik is currently scheduled to direct the ambitious mythological drama Mahavatar, centering on Bhagwan Parshuram's story, through January and June. Once that project wraps, the team will transition immediately to Stree 3, with principal photography slated to begin by the end of next year.

The threequel is officially planned for a theatrical release in 2028, with potential festive windows like Independence Day or Christmas being considered. Vijan noted that Kaushik has already finalized the script, promising an entirely unexpected trajectory for the franchise's narrative structure and character arcs.

news.title: Ajay Devgn Steps Up to Deliver Final Chapter of Drishyam 3
news.summary: As Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3 prepares for its theatrical release, all eyes are on the Hindi team to provide a satisfying conclusion to Georgekutty's saga following mixed reactions to the Malayalam version.
body: The Drishyam franchise remains one of Indian cinema's most prominent thriller series. Following the release of the Malayalam iteration led by Mohanlal, which drew mixed reactions despite strong box-office numbers in Kerala, audiences have debated whether the narrative offered a true conclusion or left too many doors open.

Attention has now shifted to the Hindi adaptation headlined by Ajay Devgn, which arrives in theaters on October 2, 2026. Makers have officially stated that this upcoming installment will serve as the final chapter of the franchise in Hindi, heightening anticipation among fans seeking definitive answers for Georgekutty's ongoing battle.

Delivering a complete and emotionally rewarding resolution presents the primary hurdle for the Hindi creative team. Meeting audience expectations with a strong climax could cement the film as a definitive finale and secure a robust performance at the box office.

news.title: The Escalating Pressure of Premiere Night Negativity and Ticket Price Hikes
news.summary: The rapid spread of harsh social media commentary and YouTube reviews during premiere nights has created a stressful environment for film teams, compounded by audience frustration over ticket price hikes.
body: Recent high-profile film premieres have highlighted a growing trend of intense social media negativity immediately upon release. Actors like Nani have openly expressed shock at the rapid wave of criticism seen during premiere screenings, a phenomenon that has increasingly impacted major theatrical releases.

The digital landscape has evolved past traditional fan rivalries into a race for online reach, where critical tweets and dramatic YouTube reviews frequently gain rapid traction. This environment places immense pressure on production teams during the opening weekend, as minor flaws are quickly amplified across digital platforms before general audiences can form their own opinions.

Compounding this issue are the rising ticket prices implemented for major star vehicles. When viewers pay extra for premiere or opening-day tickets, they often enter the theater with heightened expectations and less patience, transforming minor narrative shortcomings into major talking points and magnifying negative word-of-mouth.

news.title: Major Pan-India and International Releases Gear Up for National Holiday Weekend
news.summary: Moviegoers face a packed box office across multiple languages as a diverse lineup of star-driven projects, including Fahadh Faasil's latest and Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3, hits theaters for the October 2 national holiday.
body: An extensive lineup of multi-language releases is heading to theaters to capitalize on the October 2 national holiday falling on a Friday. The holiday weekend features a diverse mix of genres, headlined by prominent South Indian and Hindi stars testing their commercial appeal at the ticket windows.

Among the notable South releases, Fahadh Faasil takes on a full-length lead role in the Telugu-straight film Dont Trouble The Trouble, directed by Sashank Yeleti. Sandeep Kishan stars in Sigma, which also marks the directorial debut of Jason Sanjay, son of Tamil Nadu CM Vijay. Meanwhile, Nivin Pauly arrives with Sanchari, and Vijay Sethupathi stars in the Madras gangster comedy-drama Baththa, directed by Balaji Tharaneetharan.

Senior actor Shiv Raj Kumar is also entering the fray with the action drama Bail, directed by Pavan Wadeyar and featuring Deekshith Shetty. In the Hindi belt, Ajay Devgn leads the highly anticipated Drishyam 3 alongside Shriya Saran, Rajat Kapoor, Jaideep Ahlawat, and Prakash Raj, while Apoorv Singh Karki directs the Hindi remake of Premalu starring Veer Pahariya and Aafiya Sayed.

news.title: Ravi Teja's Irumudi Claims Global Top Spot on Netflix Following Theatrical Success
news.summary: Following a successful theatrical run, Ravi Teja's film Irumudi has secured the number one position globally for non-English movies on Netflix. Directed by Shiva Nirvana and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the feature has drawn over 6.8 million views on the streaming platform.
body: The action-drama Irumudi, starring Mass Maharaja Ravi Teja alongside Priya Bhavani Shankar and Baby Nakshatra, continues its strong run after transitioning from theaters to digital streaming. Directed by Shiva Nirvana and backed by producers Mythri Movie Makers, the project previously achieved robust box office collections during its theatrical release.

After dropping on Netflix on September 18, the feature quickly captured audience attention worldwide. It has officially climbed to the global number one spot among non-English films on the platform, amassing a massive viewership of over 6.8 million.

This rare dual success across both cinema halls and streaming highlights a strong connection with audiences. The project remains a significant milestone for its lead actor, director, and the entire collaborative team.

news.title: Shiva Kandukuri Leads Quirky Crime Dramedy 'Talcum Powder'
news.summary: National Award-winning producer Raj Kandukuri is presenting the new crime dramedy Talcum Powder, starring Shiva Kandukuri and directed by Sainath Ponna. The project has launched its promotional campaign with a first glimpse titled The First Sprinkle, setting up a theatrical release for November 13.
body: Dharmapatha Creations has unveiled the first promotional glimpse of its upcoming venture, Talcum Powder, titled The First Sprinkle. The film is presented by National Award-winning producer Raj Kandukuri, known for earlier acclaimed projects like Pellichoopulu and Mental Madhilo.

Directed by Sainath Ponna, the movie features Shiva Kandukuri in the lead role alongside female lead Drishika Chander. The narrative introduces Bunty, a drug peddler who encounters severe trouble after making an unintentional mistake, triggering a chain of events involving police and goons.

The quirky crime dramedy aims to deliver an unpredictable mix of humor, drama, and suspense. The supporting cast features performances by Venkatesh Maha and A Jeevan Kumar, with technical crew members including cinematographer GV Ajay Kumar, music composer Osho V, and editor Surya Ponnapalli. The film is scheduled to hit theaters on November 13.

news.title: Mahesh Babu Praises Fahadh Faasil's 'Don't Trouble The Trouble' After Special Screening
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu has shared high praise for Fahadh Faasil's upcoming Telugu film Don't Trouble The Trouble following a special screening. Directed by Shashank Yeleti and presented by S.S. Rajamouli, the movie is scheduled to release on October 2.
body: Fahadh Faasil's straight Telugu film Don't Trouble The Trouble has received a major endorsement from Superstar Mahesh Babu ahead of its theatrical release. After attending a special screening, the actor took to social media to voice his appreciation for the project.

Describing the feature as a beautifully complete experience, Mahesh Babu highlighted its rare sense of warmth, calling it entertaining and moving in equal measure. He also lauded the onscreen chemistry between Fahadh Faasil and Ssara, while commending S.S. Kartikeya on his maiden production venture.

Directed by debutant Shashank Yeleti, the film is produced by Shobu Yarlagadda, Prasad Devineni, and S.S. Karthikeya under Arka Media Works and Showing Business, with S.S. Rajamouli presenting. The project previously received a promotional boost from actor NTR at its pre-release event ahead of its October 2 premiere.

news.title: Chandoo Mondeti Confirms Bilingual Project with Rana Daggubati and Akshay Kumar
news.summary: Filmmaker Chandoo Mondeti has verified that he is teaming up with Rana Daggubati and Akshay Kumar for a Hindi-Telugu bilingual tentatively titled Mahakaal. The director clarified that the mythological drama is still in early pre-production and has no connection to Sanjay Leela Bhansali.
body: Filmmaker Chandoo Mondeti has broken his silence regarding swirling speculation about his next directorial venture, confirming that he is indeed teaming up with Rana Daggubati and Bollywood star Akshay Kumar. Speaking about the project, the director revealed that the upcoming venture is planned as a Hindi-Telugu bilingual tentatively titled Mahakaal. While details are still emerging, it has been confirmed that Karan Johar is lined up to produce the Hindi version through Rana Daggubati, whereas conversations to lock a major banner for the Telugu version are actively underway.

Addressing the current status of the film, Mondeti emphasized that the venture remains in its preliminary stages. The core team is presently occupied with story discussions, finalizing key technicians, and laying the groundwork for pre-production. The director also debunked circulating rumors linking Bollywood filmmaker Sanjay Leela Bhansali to the script, clarifying that the narrative and direction are entirely his own creation, though he remains in talks with Bhansali for a separate future collaboration.

The collaboration materialed after Mondeti pitched multiple ideas to Rana Daggubati during meetings in Mumbai, ultimately zeroing in on a grand mythological subject. The director noted that choosing a mythological backdrop was an organic choice inspired by the rich history of Ujjain and the birthplace of Lord Shiva, steering away from any conscious attempt to replicate previous franchise patterns.

This high-profile bilingual brings together notable talents across industries, generating substantial anticipation among fans of pan-Indian cinema. As pre-production rolls forward, audiences await further official announcements regarding casting additions and definitive shooting timelines.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Spotlight Colonial Exploitation in Ranabaali Episode Two
news.summary: Actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika have shared fresh historical insights in the second episode of the promotional documentary series for Ranabaali. They highlighted how the British utilized the Indian railway network to rapidly drain local resources like grains, spices, and cotton to ports. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the film is slated for release on October 16.
body: The creative team behind the upcoming film Ranabaali has continued its unique promotional rollout, releasing the second installment of a four-part documentary series designed to contextualize the historical backdrop of the movie. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the feature stars Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika, who appeared in the latest video segment to unpack lesser-known historical realities surrounding British colonial rule in India.

In the newly unveiled episode, the lead actors discussed how the British administration established the Indian railway system primarily to accelerate the transport of indigenous grains, spices, cotton, and gold directly to ports rather than to build domestic infrastructure. Vijay Deverakonda pointed out that because historical textbooks were historically penned by colonial authorities, crucial facts regarding systemic resource extraction were deliberately omitted from standard syllabi.

Echoing these sentiments, Rashmika expressed how delving deep into the actual historical events of the era deeply impacted her perspective. This educational documentary approach follows the first episode's clarification that Ranabaali focuses specifically on a man-made famine caused by grain appropriation in the Madras Presidency—which tragically claimed the lives of one crore Indians—rather than a traditional freedom struggle narrative.

With Ranabaali scheduled to hit the big screen on October 16, these informative documentary shorts are successfully building distinct thematic curiosity among moviegoers, shifting attention toward the grave historical events that shape the fictional drama.

news.title: Maadhav Bhupathiraju’s Debut Drama Maremma Locks OTT Streaming Date
news.summary: Maremma, the rural drama marking the acting debut of Ravi Teja's nephew Maadhav Bhupathiraju, is heading to digital platforms. The film will premiere simultaneously on Aha and Amazon Prime Video on October 9, 2026, following its theatrical run in September.
body: The rural drama Maremma, which marked the acting debut of Maadhav Bhupathiraju—nephew of Tollywood star Ravi Teja—is officially making its transition to digital streaming. Following its theatrical debut on September 10, 2026, the film has locked its official OTT premiere date for early October.

According to reports, leading streaming services Aha and Amazon Prime Video have secured the digital distribution rights for the project. The movie is scheduled to drop across both platforms on October 9, 2026, with an official formal announcement anticipated shortly.

Directed by Manchala Nagaraj and produced by Mayur Reddy Bandaru, Maremma features an ensemble cast including Deepa Balu, Vikas Vasishta, Vinod Kumar, V.S. Rupa Lakshmi, and Dayanand Reddy in prominent roles. The musical score for the rural entertainer was composed by Prashanth R. Vihari and Bipradeep Dutta.
The simultaneous dual-platform release gives fans who missed the theatrical run an accessible opportunity to catch the newcomer's debut project from the comfort of their homes.

news.title: Makers of Prabhas’ Fauji in No Hurry to Finalize New Release Date
news.summary: The Prabhas and Hanu Raghavapudi project Fauji has postponed its December 3 release date indefinitely as principal photography continues. Producers have chosen not to rush a new date announcement because significant shooting remains, with Prabhas committed to finishing upcoming work on Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit first.
body: The highly anticipated period action drama Fauji, starring Prabhas alongside debutante female lead Imanvi, has faced further scheduling shifts. Following multiple postponements, its planned December 3 release date has now been deferred indefinitely as the production team refuses to rush the completion timeline.

According to industry insiders, the producers have decided against announcing a fresh release date until principal photography is officially wrapped. A substantial portion of the film's shooting is still pending, with reports indicating that Prabhas requires upwards of 60 working days to complete his remaining portions.

Complicating the timeline further are the actor's concurrent commitments to director Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s upcoming film Spirit. Fulfilling these intersecting production schedules is expected to take roughly four months, leaving the core production house without definitive clarity on when Fauji will completely wrap filming.

While speculations pointed toward a potential release date update coinciding with Prabhas’ birthday on October 23, sources suggest the makers will likely bypass theatrical announcements on that day. Instead, fans can expect fresh promotional assets or a new poster to mark the occasion without committing to a concrete calendar slot.

news.title: Karthi's Quick OTT Premieres Spark Concern Over Shrinking Theatrical Windows
news.summary: Tamil star Karthi's recent films have moved to Amazon Prime Video within weeks of their theatrical releases following weak box-office runs. Trade analysts warn that these rapid digital debuts could negatively impact future audience turnout and cinema recovery times.
body: Tamil actor Karthi's recent cinematic outings have drawn attention from trade analysts due to remarkably brief theatrical windows. His spy sequel, Sardar 2, began streaming on Amazon Prime Video just 21 days after its theatrical debut, following a struggling box-office run. This follows a similar trajectory seen earlier with his Pongal comedy-action release, Vaa Vaathiyar.

Released during the competitive Sankranti festive season across five languages, Vaa Vaathiyar failed to capture substantial audiences in cinemas. Producers swiftly transitioned the film to the digital platform merely 14 days after its initial release. With Sardar 2 adopting a similarly expedited timeline, a pattern has emerged for the actor's projects this year.

Typically, prominent commercial features enjoy an exclusive cinema run ranging between four to eight weeks. This extended window allows distributors and theater operators sufficient opportunity to recoup investments through ticket sales. The recent trend of sub-month digital arrivals has therefore raised concerns among exhibitors.

Industry observers note that rapid streaming premieres risk altering consumer behavior. If audiences anticipate that underperforming titles will arrive on home screens within two to three weeks, advance bookings and opening-weekend footfalls could decrease, leaving exhibitors with limited time to sustain revenue.

news.title: Shiva Kandukuri's 'Talcum Powder' Glimpse Promises a Wholesome Comedy
news.summary: The newly released glimpse of 'Talcum Powder' introduces a humorous take on a drug syndicate background. Directed by Sainath Ponna and produced by Raj Kandukuri, the film is scheduled to hit theaters on November 13.
body: The makers of the upcoming Telugu film Talcum Powder have released its first official glimpse, signaling a comedic take on unconventional subject matter. Headlined by Shiva Kandukuri and Drishika Chander, the project is directed by Sainath Ponna and backed by National Award-winning producer Raj Kandukuri.

Rather than adopting a gritty, dark tone typical of crime narratives, the newly unveiled footage situates its story against the backdrop of a drug network while maintaining a distinctly lighthearted atmosphere. The narrative follows a young protagonist, played by Shiva Kandukuri, navigating encounters with various peddlers and dealers.

The preview highlights the protagonist's comic timing alongside an array of quirky characters and situations. Buoyed by sharp one-liners and imaginative visual direction by Sainath Ponna, the glimpse aims to build audience anticipation ahead of the film's theatrical release.
Talcum Powder is officially slated to arrive in cinemas on November 13, bringing a fresh dramedy perspective to the big screen.
